Sleet Storm (Weather4 Conj): R840' 40' radius, 20' high cylinder blocks sight, extinguishes small fires, and requires a DC 10 Balance check to move at half Speed (failure by 5 or more causes a fall) for 11 rd
Song Of Discord (Passion7 Ench): R200' Causes creatures in a 20' radius to have a 50% chance each rd of attacking the nearest creature (save Will DC 20 negates) for 10 rd
Spell Resistance (Meditation5 Abju): Gives touched SR 22 (save Will DC 18 negates) for 10 min
Spell Turning (Meditation7 Abju): Reflects 1d4+6 levels of targeted, non-ranged-touch spells directed at self within 100 min onto their caster; spells between casters who are both warded by Spell Turning produce one of these effects: 70% dissipate with no effect; 10% affect both casters; 17% disable both casters' Spell Turning for 1d4 min; 3% send both casters to another plane
Spirit Steed (Deathless4 Necr): Gives the touched living animal +30' Speed, an increased run multiplier, and immunity to hustle damage (save Will DC 17 negates) for 11 hr; the target suffers fatigue afterward
Status (Community2 Divi): Allows monitoring the condition and position of 3 touched living creatures (save Will DC 15 negates) for 10 hr
Stone Shape (Artifice3 Tran): Reshapes 20 cubic feet of stone
Storm Of Vengeance (Weather9 Conj): R800' Creates a 360' radius storm that inflicts deafened for 1d4x10 min (save Fortitude DC 22 negates), then produces rain that inflicts 1d6 HP acid, then generates lightning bolts that inflict 10d6 HP electricity on 6 targets (save Reflex DC 22 half), then creates hail that inflicts 5d6 HP bludgeoning, then produces violent wind and rain that reduce Speed by 3/4 and obscure vision, giving a 20% miss chance on attacks within 5' and a 50% miss chance on more distant attacks, for 6 rd; the storm also prevents ranged attacks and disrupts spellcasting (save Concentration negates; add the level of the spell to be cast to the DC)
Suggestion (Charm3 Ench): R50' Causes the living target to follow a reasonable suggestion (save Will DC 16 negates) for up to 10 hr
Sympathy (Community8 Ench): R50' Attracts a specified intelligent creature kind or alignment to a target object or a 100 cubic foot area (save Will DC 21 negates; requires another save 1d6x10 min later) for 20 hr
Tasha's Hideous Laughter (Passion2 Ench): R50' Causes a target with an Intelligence of at least 3 to fall into uncontrollable laughter (save Will DC 15 negates, creatures of a different type than the caster have +4 on the save) for 10 rd
Tongues (Commerce3 Divi): Allows touched to speak and understand any language (save Will DC 16 negates) for 100 min
Tongues (Meditation4 Divi): Allows touched to speak and understand any language (save Will DC 17 negates) for 100 min
Touch Of Madness (Madness2 Ench): Melee touch attack inflicts dazed on the living target for 20 rd (save Will DC 15 negates)
True Creation (Artifice8 Conj): R50' Creates a permanent 11 cubic foot vegetable or mineral object
True Seeing (Commerce5 Divi): Allows touched to see things as they really are (save Will DC 18 negates) for 10 min: to see through 120' darkness, illusion, and invisibility, note secret doors, and see the true forms of polymorphed items
Vampiric Touch (Necromancer3 Necr): Melee touch attack inflicts 5d6 HP on the living target and gives self the same number of temporary hit points for 1 hr
Waves Of Fatigue (Necromancer5 Necr): 30' cone inflicts fatigued
Weird (Madness9 Illu): R200' Uses the fears of targets in a 15' radius to create creatures (save Will DC 22 upon interaction disbelieves) whose touch kills its target (save Fortitude DC 22 inflicts 3d6 HP, 1d4 points of Strength damage, and stunned for 1 rd)
Whirlwind (Weather8 Evoc): R800' Creates a 10' radius, 30' high cyclone that moves 60' as directed each rd, inflicting 3d6 HP on Large and smaller creatures (save Reflex DC 21 negates), for 10 rd; it traps Medium and smaller creatures (save Reflex DC 21 negates), inflicting an additional 1d8 HP on each subsequent rd
Withering Palm (Decay7 Necr): Melee touch attack inflicts on a living target 5 points of Strength and Constitution damage (save Fortitude DC 20 negates); a critical hit inflicts ability drain instead of damage
Wood Shape (Artifice2 Tran): Reshapes a 20 cubic feet piece of wood (save Will DC 15 negates)
Zone Of Truth (Commerce2 Ench): R50' Prevents creatures in a 20' radius from lying (save Will DC 15 negates) for 10 min
Magic Notes:
Empowered Creation: +1 caster level on Creation spells
Empowered Necromancy: +1 caster level on Necromancy spells
Wisdom Cleric Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level C1, C2, C3
Add Life: Touched gains 1d6+10 temporary HP for 10 hr
Augment Summoning: Summoned creatures gain +4 Strength and Constitution
Boost Spell: Can increase a spell's variable effects by 50% once per day
Community Leader: Can use Calm Emotions as a spell-like ability once per day
Spontaneous Casting (Cleric): Can cast Cure or Inflict spells in place of prepared spells
